source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: AXP2101 PWROK (pin 29) and VBACKUP (pin 27) are unconnected. Could you route both to small test pads / vias next to the AXP2101? That way we can stuff a backup cap or coin cell on VBACKUP later if we want RTC retention or wake-from-off, and we'd have access to PWROK for debug. Just signal traces, no power — should be a quick change.

value_updates.access_method: small test pad or via next to the AXP2101

routing_warnings.description: The implementation claim explicitly covers VBACKUP and VRTC but does not state that PWROK debug access was added.
